explanations.label: Ambient Occlusion
explanations.path: Video > Advanced Video > Presets > Ambient Occlusion
explanations.explanation: Calculate lighting using Ambient Occlusion. Enabling Ambient Occlusion can degrade graphics performance. Trade-off: Adds contact shading but can degrade performance (Valve).
explanations.catalogDescription: Calculate lighting using Ambient Occlusion. Enabling Ambient Occlusion can degrade graphics performance.
explanations.tradeoffs: Adds contact shading but can degrade performance (Valve).

recommendations.whyForGoal: Valve notes that increasing anti-aliasing quality can degrade graphics performance, so a lower mode may help if the GPU is the bottleneck.
recommendations.tradeoff: Higher sample counts cost more GPU time; lower settings show more jagged edges.

recommendations.whyForGoal: Valve says "Sun Only" can improve graphics performance.
recommendations.tradeoff: "Sun Only" can improve performance but might leave you at a competitive disadvantage, particularly indoors (Valve).

recommendations.whyForGoal: Valve says decreasing it may improve performance on low-end systems.
recommendations.tradeoff: Lower detail may improve performance on low-end systems but degrades image quality (Valve).

recommendations.whyForGoal: Valve notes higher shader detail can degrade graphics performance.
recommendations.tradeoff: High looks better but can degrade performance (Valve).

recommendations.whyForGoal: Valve notes higher particle detail can degrade graphics performance.
recommendations.tradeoff: Higher detail can degrade performance, especially in effect-heavy moments (Valve).

recommendations.whyForGoal: Valve notes enabling Ambient Occlusion can degrade graphics performance.
recommendations.tradeoff: Adds contact shading but can degrade performance (Valve).

recommendations.whyForGoal: Valve notes enabling it can degrade graphics performance.
recommendations.tradeoff: Adds surface depth but can degrade performance (Valve).

recommendations.whyForGoal: Valve says Performance potentially increases performance and reduces GPU memory use.
recommendations.tradeoff: Performance mode lowers HDR quality but may increase performance and reduce GPU memory use (Valve).

recommendations.whyForGoal: Shadow rendering is commonly one of the more expensive effects; a step down may reduce GPU load (no Valve-published measurement).
recommendations.tradeoff: Higher shadow quality generally costs more GPU time; the exact effect is hardware dependent.

recommendations.whyForGoal: Showing frame time and FPS lets you measure whether other changes actually help on your machine.
